digest.component_or_area: store event append and ticket creation
propositions: ticket directory creation races with interruption between os.makedirs and first event file write, leaving empty dirs reported by fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
atomic publication requires building directory and first event together in a staging path and publishing with single os.rename under the write lock
staging dirs use dot-prefixed naming convention (.tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex>) to remain invisible to existing fsck scanners without code changes
batch_stage_and_commit shares the vulnerable makedirs-then-die window with single-event stage_and_commit and must be converted to use StagedEvent.promote
sweep_stale_staging removes only stale staging dirs owned by dead processes and never touches ticket directories or store data (respects bug 043f boundary)
lock discipline unchanged: rename happens under write lock so events remain invisible until rebase guard and under_lock_check pass
